description: Supported HTTP header redaction behavior and input representations.

dos: Replace sensitive HTTP header values while preserving safe names and values.
Support plain objects, Headers-style objects exposing entries(), and arrays of [name, value] entries.
Normalize object and Headers-style inputs to a null-prototype object; preserve the array shape of entry-array inputs.
Skip malformed entries and entries whose names are not strings; skip malformed entries yielded by Headers-style iterators.
Process at most the first 1,000 entries from a Headers-style iterator; omit later entries without an additional marker.
donts: Do not treat arbitrary iterable objects without an entries() method as supported header inputs.
Do not imply that all input representations preserve their original shape.
